purpose: Frozen exact bytes of resumed P0 canonical (pre-F1) TwinSAFE sources. Base side of the P0->F1 exact delta proof (MIG-1, review condition C5). Do not refresh to match a changed source.
obtainedWith: git cat-file blob <commit>:<repoPath> > <file> (raw blob, no EOL conversion; repoPaths are -text in root .gitattributes)
crossCheck: Byte-identical (same SHA256) to SafetyTests/candidates/resumed-p0/native/* at creation time.
consumers: test/helpers/v2-structural.js after MIG-1 (base of check-source-pair.mjs and scripts/f1-delta-check.mjs)
